Welcome to Sourcery
Getting Started¶
Setting Up Your Account¶

Learn how to set up Sourcery and get your first reviews.

Connecting Your Repos¶

Link Sourcery to your GitHub or GitLab Repos.

Adding Sourcery to Your IDE¶

Get feedback earlier in the process by adding Sourcery to VS Code, Cursor, or Jetbrains IDEs.

Adding and Managing Team Members¶

Bring Sourcery to your full team for continuous code reviews.

Code Reviews¶
Reviews on Pull Requests¶

Have Sourcery provide immediate feedback on every new PR.

Reviews in IDE¶

Get Sourcery's reviews on existing code or get reviews while you work.

Customizing Sourcery's Reviews¶

Configure the structure and language of reviews, add custom rules, and tailor what you see in reviews.

Interacting with Sourcery¶

Give Sourcery feedback to improve its reviews and trigger reviews, issue creation, and more.

Security Scanning¶
Managing Your Repos¶

Control where and when Sourcery scans for security issues.

Security Scan Reports¶

Dive into Sourcery's security reports to identify critical issues.

Resolving Security Issues¶

Learn how to fix and manage critical issues and filter out non-issues.
